methodology: synthetic fault seeding; original generated MR oracle; conventional baseline exact output assertions from deterministic synthetic reference model using same source and followup inputs (2 executions each); not independent real-world baseline; no clinical inference
limitations: Mutants were authored against the same synthetic reference implementations used to derive the expected conventional outputs.
The conventional exact-output baseline uses stronger oracle information than metamorphic relations, although both evaluate the same source and follow-up cases.
Observationally indistinguishable mutants are not necessarily globally equivalent.
Synthetic temporal/trajectory policies are not clinical CDS implementations.
Selected synthetic cases were constructed to exercise the archived transformations, not random samples.
